subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this durable-runtime schema, environment controls, CLI/Gateway protocol, and agent/message lifecycle integration on the 2026.7.1 release line?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible and CI-clean, but tests cannot decide whether these new persistent and public contracts are the intended long-term product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor after proof
options.body: Approve the durable-core direction after inspectable exact-head upgrade, recovery, and delivery evidence is attached.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Land shared-state and runtime primitives first, deferring public controls and existing delivery integrations to separately reviewed PRs.

options.title: Do not adopt
options.body: Close the implementation stack if durable core is not planned for this release line.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after proof
recommendation.body: Approve the durable-core direction after inspectable exact-head upgrade, recovery, and delivery evidence is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing Gateway and subagent lifecycle history provides the strongest available routing signal for this cross-runtime product decision.
